display.purpose: Page-level hero text only — landing/404/marquee. Brushed cursive for spray-paint emphasis.

headline.purpose: Page titles and the heaviest UI labels. Condensed riot-flyer sans, always uppercase.

title.purpose: Section stamps, dialog titles. The most-used heading in the app.

gothic.purpose: Navigation links and character names. Reserved for items that should feel like a sigil.

label.purpose: Form labels and stat labels. Tracking-heavy uppercase — the project's trade-dress voice.

micro-label.purpose: Stat chips, footer microcopy, action button text. The smallest typographic register.

body.purpose: Long-form prose: equipment descriptions, abilities, notes. Cap line length at 65–75ch.

shadows.name: stamp-shadow
shadows.purpose: Default stamped-on-page treatment for section headings, action buttons, snackbar alerts.

shadows.name: pink-stamp-shadow
shadows.purpose: Loud accent shadow for nav hover, menus, and dialog containers. One use per screen.

shadows.name: hover-shadow
shadows.purpose: Resting shadow on action / footer / kill buttons; grows by 1px on hover.

shadows.name: dialog-shadow
shadows.purpose: Reserved for modal/dialog frames — the loudest shadow in the system.

shadows.name: card-glow
shadows.purpose: The one allowed soft shadow — equipment card hover only, simulating magenta fluorescence.

motion.name: kachunk-fast
motion.purpose: Default transition for buttons. Snappy 'physical click' feel.

motion.name: kachunk-medium
motion.purpose: Equipment card hover and other surface transitions.

motion.name: translate-up-left
motion.purpose: Hover lift primitive — pair with shadow growth in the opposite direction.

components.name: Save Button
components.description: Primary save action — yellow stamp button with hard black drop shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-save { background: #FFE900; color: #0a0a0a; font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif; font-size: 1.2rem; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; border: 2px solid #0a0a0a; border-radius: 0; padding: 8px 24px; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #0a0a0a; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-save:hover { background: #f5f5f5; transform: translate(-2px, -2px); box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 #0a0a0a; } .ds-btn-save:active { transform: translate(0, 0); box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #0a0a0a; } .ds-btn-save:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FFE900; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Action Button (Yellow Ghost)
components.description: Inline action — transparent with yellow border, fills yellow on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-action { background: transparent; color: #FFE900; font-family: 'Antonio', sans-serif; font-size: 0.7rem; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; border: 1px solid #FFE900; border-radius: 0; padding: 4px 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-action:hover { background: #FFE900; color: #0a0a0a; } .ds-btn-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FFE900; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Kill Button
components.description: Destructive blood-red action with yellow Antonio microcopy.
components.css: .ds-btn-kill { background: #8b0000; color: #FFE900; font-family: 'Antonio', sans-serif; font-size: 0.65rem; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; border: 2px solid #0a0a0a; border-radius: 0; padding: 6px 24px; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #0a0a0a; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-kill:hover { background: #FF3EB5; color: #0a0a0a; transform: translate(-1px, -1px); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #8b0000; } .ds-btn-kill:active { transform: translate(0, 0); box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #0a0a0a; }

components.name: Section Stamp
components.description: The signature heading element — yellow rubber-stamp block, slightly tilted.
components.css: .ds-section-stamp { display: inline-block; background: #FFE900; color: #0a0a0a; font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif; font-size: 1.5rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; border: 3px solid #0a0a0a; border-radius: 0; padding: 2px 10px; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #0a0a0a; transform: rotate(-0.6deg); margin: 0 0 12px; user-select: none; }

components.name: Notes Card
components.description: Yellow Post-it card with hard drop shadow and slight tilt — for handwritten-feel content.
components.html:
NOTES

The miser's coin sat heavy in my pocket as I crossed the dying field…
components.css: .ds-notes-card { background: #FFE900; padding: 20px; border-radius: 0; box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 #0a0a0a; transform: rotate(0.2deg); display: block; max-width: 480px; } .ds-notes-title { display: inline-block; background: #FFE900; color: #0a0a0a; font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif; font-size: 1.5rem; text-transform: uppercase; border: 3px solid #0a0a0a; padding: 2px 10px; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #0a0a0a; transform: rotate(0.3deg); margin: 0 0 12px; } .ds-notes-body { color: #0a0a0a; font-family: 'Alegreya', Georgia, serif; font-style: italic; font-size: 0.9rem; line-height: 1.5; margin: 0; }

components.name: Equipment Card
components.description: Dark item row with pink fluorescence on hover — the only blurred shadow allowed.
components.css: .ds-equipment-card { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 12px; background: #111111; color: #f5f5f5; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; overflow: visible; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0, 0.2, 1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-equipment-card:hover { background: #1a1a1a; border-color: #FF3EB5; box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(255, 62, 181, 0.3), inset 0 0 12px rgba(255, 62, 181, 0.05); } .ds-equipment-name { color: #FFE900; font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-equipment-meta { color: #888888; font-family: 'Antonio', sans-serif; font-size: 0.65rem; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; margin-left: auto; }

components.name: Nav Link (Active)
components.description: Tilted gothic nav tile — yellow text on black, with pink offset shadow.
components.css: .ds-nav-active { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 100px; height: 44px; background: #0a0a0a; color: #FFE900; font-family: 'MedievalSharp', serif; font-size: 1.2rem; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; border: 3px solid #FFE900; border-radius: 0; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #FF3EB5; transform: rotate(-1.5deg); transition: all 0.2s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-active:hover { transform: rotate(-2deg) scale(1.02); box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 #FFE900; color: #FF3EB5; } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FFE900; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Stat Chip
components.description: Square uppercase chip — Antonio microcopy, fill colored by stat.
components.css: .ds-chip-stat { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 8px; background: #2d5a27; color: #FFE900; font-family: 'Antonio', sans-serif; font-size: 0.65rem; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; border-radius: 0; }

components.name: Snackbar (Error)
components.description: Toast notification — blood ground, yellow text, hard black drop shadow.
components.html: FAILED TO SAVE CHARACTER
components.css: .ds-snackbar-error { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 12px 16px; background: #8b0000; color: #FFE900; font-family: 'Antonio', sans-serif; font-size: 0.8rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; border: 2px solid #0a0a0a; border-radius: 0; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #0a0a0a; } .ds-snackbar-error svg { flex: 0 0 auto; }

components.name: Resource Input (HP / Omens)
components.description: Yellow stamp value with centered Bebas Neue numerals — for HP, Omens, ability scores.
components.css: .ds-resource-label { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; } .ds-resource-label-text { color: #0a0a0a; font-family: 'Antonio', sans-serif; font-size: 0.7rem; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-resource-input { width: 80px; height: 48px; padding: 6px; text-align: center; background: #FFE900; color: #0a0a0a; font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif; font-size: 1.6rem; border: 2px solid #0a0a0a; border-radius: 0; outline: none; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #0a0a0a; -moz-appearance: textfield; } .ds-resource-input::-webkit-outer-spin-button, .ds-resource-input::-webkit-inner-spin-button { -webkit-appearance: none; margin: 0; } .ds-resource-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FF3EB5; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Scvm Grinder is an interactive character sheet for Mörk Borg, the Swedish doom-metal tabletop RPG, and the interface dresses for the part. It is a xerox-punk illuminated manuscript: a black bunker stamped onto a screaming yellow page, with hot pink interruptions and blood-red warnings. Every surface is hard-edged, slightly tilted, and sits on top of a faint fractal-noise overlay so the screen reads less like a web app and more like a photocopied zine that survived the apocalypse.

Density is high, rhythm is jagged. Section headings are stamped on like rubber-stamp insignia (yellow ground, black 3px border, hard 4px black drop shadow, rotated 0.3–0.6°). Buttons lift with translate(-2px, -2px) and grow their shadow rather than fading or scaling — every interaction has a physical 'ka-chunk' feel. There are no gradients, no rounded corners (borderRadius: 0 is the global doctrine), no glass, no soft drop shadows. Shadows are always solid offsets in a brand color — the chunky black-or-pink box-shadow is the project's signature.

This system explicitly rejects: SaaS-clean Material rounded corners, dark-mode 'elegant' interfaces, gradient-text headlines, glassmorphism, parchment-and-gold 'fantasy generic' aesthetics, soft pastels, and the hero-metric template.
keyCharacteristics: Yellow-as-paper, black-as-ink, pink-as-blood. The body background is #FFE900; cards and content surfaces are #0a0a0a islands stamped onto it.
Zero corner radius everywhere. shape.borderRadius: 0 overrides MUI's defaults; sharp edges are the brand.
Hard-offset shadows in brand colors. 4px 4px 0 #0a0a0a and 6px 6px 0 #FF3EB5; never blurred.
Tilted decorative elements. Nav links, stamps, and notes sit at 0.2°–1.5° rotation. Committed, not whimsical.

Six fonts, each with one job. Caveat Brush (display brush), Bebas Neue (UI headlines), MedievalSharp (gothic identity), Antonio (tracking-heavy labels), Alegreya (body prose), Black Ops One (loaded but reserved).
Print mode is a different system. When body.print-route-active is set, the design becomes a black-on-cream A4 editorial sheet — Arial Black headlines, hairline borders, no color.

rules.name: The Yellow-on-Black Rule
rules.body: The screen is yellow paper with black-ink content cards stamped onto it. Reverse this only inside dialog title bars, section stamps, and the save button — places where you want the surface itself to roar.

rules.name: The Pink Tax Rule
rules.body: Hot pink (#FF3EB5) is the interrupt. Every additional pink element on a screen weakens the previous one. Aim for one pink hover at a time. Two is loud. Three is noise.

rules.name: The No Soft Pink Rule
rules.body: There are no light pinks, salmon, or rose tones in this system. Pink either appears at full saturation #FF3EB5 or doesn't appear at all.

rules.name: The Six-Voice Rule
rules.body: Six fonts are loaded. Each one has exactly one job. Never use Caveat Brush for a button. Never set body copy in Bebas Neue. Never use MedievalSharp for labels. The friction holds because each face is locked to its role.

rules.name: The Always-Uppercase Rule
rules.body: Every heading, button, label, and chip is text-transform: uppercase. Sentence-case is reserved for body copy in Alegreya and italic placeholder text in the notes panel.

rules.name: The Antonio-for-Labels Rule
rules.body: Antonio with 0.15em–0.35em letter-spacing is the project's 'trade dress' voice — small, wide, cold. It carries the Mörk Borg feel. Reach for it for labels and microcopy before reaching for Bebas.

rules.name: The Solid-Shadow Rule
rules.body: All decorative shadows are solid offsets in #0a0a0a or #FF3EB5. Blurred shadows are forbidden except on the equipment card glow and the print preview frame. If you find yourself reaching for rgba(0,0,0,0.1) to soften something, the answer is to use no shadow at all.

rules.name: The Translate-Up-Left Rule
rules.body: Hover lift moves the element to translate(-2px, -2px), never down or right. The shadow, conversely, grows down-right. The directional pairing is part of the brand's kinetic language.

dos: Do keep borderRadius: 0 on every surface, button, input, and chip. The square corner is the brand.
Do use hard-offset solid shadows (4px 4px 0 #0a0a0a, 6px 6px 0 #FF3EB5) for elevation. Never blurred shadows except on the equipment card hover glow.
Do translate -2px, -2px on button and card hover, paired with a 1px shadow growth in the same direction.
Do rotate decorative section stamps and the notes card by 0.2°–1.5°. The tilt is committed, not random — pick a direction and an angle.
Do lock each font to one role: Caveat Brush for display, Bebas Neue for headlines and buttons, MedievalSharp for navigation and character names, Antonio for labels, Alegreya for body.
Do use Antonio with 0.15em–0.35em letter-spacing for all small uppercase labels.
Do treat hot pink (#FF3EB5) as a budget — one loud pink hover or shadow per screen at most.
Do stamp every major section heading inside a yellow rubber-stamp block (3px black border, 4×4 black drop shadow, slight tilt).
Do preserve the print mode as a different visual system. Do not try to harmonize the two — they are intentionally distinct.
Do keep the body text background as raw #FFE900 yellow with a faint fractal-noise overlay (4% opacity SVG turbulence). The page is the paper.
donts: Don't introduce rounded corners anywhere. No borderRadius: 4, no 8, no lg. Square only.
Don't use blurred drop shadows. The Solid-Shadow Rule is absolute.
Don't use gradient-text (background-clip: text), gradient backgrounds, or linear-gradient decoration anywhere on screen.
Don't use Material Design or generic SaaS-clean patterns. If the design would look at home in a Stripe dashboard or an admin template, it's wrong.
Don't use glassmorphism, backdrop blurs, frosted panels, or 'elegant dark mode' patterns. The brand is harsh, not refined.
Don't introduce parchment textures, gold leaf, 'fantasy generic' gradients, or RPG-store-page aesthetics. Mörk Borg is doom metal, not D&D 5e.
Don't soften pink. There are no rose, salmon, or pastel pinks. #FF3EB5 or nothing.
Don't use light grays for borders (#ccc, #eee). Borders are #0a0a0a, #1a1a1a, #2a2a2a, or #FFE900 — nothing in between.
Don't add a sixth font face or use any of the existing six outside its assigned role.
Don't reach for <Modal> as a first instinct. Inline panels and drawers are the default; modals are reserved for destructive confirmation and authentication.
Don't scale or fade buttons on hover. The hover language is translate-and-shadow, not scale or opacity.
Don't use #000 or #fff directly. Use #0a0a0a and #f5f5f5 — the warmth is intentional.
Don't add side-stripe borders (border-left: 4px solid #X) on cards or alerts. If the alert needs identity, color the entire fill.
